```r
fit_als <- function(lambda, tol = 1e-6, max_iter = 100) {
 fit <- [copy](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/copy.html)(train_set)
 N <- [nrow](https://rdrr.io/r/base/nrow.html)(fit)
 mu <- [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(fit$rating)
 fit[, `:=`(a = 0, b = 0)]  # starting values
 for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
 a_old <- [copy](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/copy.html)(fit$a)
 b_old <- [copy](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/reference/copy.html)(fit$b)

 fit[, a := [sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(rating - mu - b)/(.N + N*lambda) , by = userId]
 fit[, b := [sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(rating - mu - a)/(.N + N*lambda), by = movieId]

 delta <- [max](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Extremes.html)([c](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)([abs](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)(fit$a - a_old), [abs](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)(fit$b - b_old)))
 if (delta < tol) break
 }
 [return](https://rdrr.io/r/base/function.html)([with](https://rdrr.io/r/base/with.html)(fit, [list](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.html)(mu = mu, a = [setNames](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/setNames.html)(a, userId), b = [setNames](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/setNames.html)(b, movieId))))
}
```

```r
fit <- fit_als(lambda = 0.0001)
mu <- fit$mu; a_reg <- fit$a; b_reg <- fit$b
```
